context: The S156/DE1 live evidence — the streamed export endpoint on the remediated dev tree: GET /api/export/data answers 200 with the download headers; the body arrives CHUNKED (transfer-encoding) and is byte-complete (X-Export-Bytes === the actual received UTF-8 byte count — the strengthened s21/DE3 contract, live); the envelope parses with all 20 manifest keys and internally-consistent counts; the secret guard holds; and the LIVE round-trip POSTs the streamed body back to /api/import/data for the idempotent restore (created: 0 — the S139-CN2 witness class).
